answer_sql:
SELECT
  co.country_name AS customer_country,
  ROUND(SUM(s.net_amount), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_customer AS cu
  ON s.customer_key = cu.customer_key
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS co
  ON cu.country_code = co.country_code
GROUP BY
  co.country_name
ORDER BY
  net_revenue DESC

body.value: These eight rows are the answer as returned: for each country where Contoso has registered customers, the money those customers were actually charged after discount, in US dollars, across every order placed from 2016-05-18 to 2025-12-31, in a shop or on the web. The United States 111,862,187.56 — just over half the business — then Germany 24,638,830.18, Canada 23,242,027.53, the United Kingdom 23,049,533.37, Australia 13,360,672.61, the Netherlands 9,421,520.47, France 6,674,724.85, Italy 6,564,975.09. They add to 218,814,471.66, which is the whole of net revenue, so no sale is missing and none sits in an 'unknown' row. WHAT IS NOT IN THESE FIGURES: only discount is deducted — the bundle records no returns, refunds, taxes or shipping, so 'net' means after discount and nothing more; no order is dropped for being cancelled or unpaid, because the sales data holds no status to drop on; no period is cut away; and the country is where the BUYER is registered, not where the till was, which is why the 86,790,054.13 taken through the web shop is distributed across these eight countries instead of appearing as a line of its own.
